ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, \\
it follows that AD=AB, BO=OD, $\angle$DAO=$\angle$BAO=25$^\circ$, AC$\perp$BD, \\
therefore $\angle$ABD=65$^\circ$, \\
since DH$\perp$AB, BO=DO, \\
it follows that HO=DO, \\
thus $\angle$DHO=$\angle$BDH=90$^\circ$-$\angle$ABD=\boxed{25^\circ}.

method.method_draft: Analytic coordinate/slope route. First read the figure: AC is the horizontal diagonal through O, BD is the other diagonal through O with D above and B below, H is the foot from D to AB, and OH is the segment whose angle with HD is required. Put O at the origin, take AC as the x-axis and BD as the y-axis. By the kite symmetry visible in the diagram, let A = (-1,0), D = (0,t), B = (0,-t), where the scale choice A=(-1,0) is arbitrary. From the text, ∠CAD = 25°, so the line AD makes a 25° angle with the positive x-axis; hence t = tan 25°. The line AB has slope -t, so the altitude DH through D has slope 1/t. Solve the intersection of y = -t(x+1) and y = t + x/t to get H. Then compute slopes from H: the slope of HD is 1/t = tan 65°, while the slope of HO simplifies to (1-t^2)/(2t) = cot 50° = tan 40°. Therefore the angle between HD and HO is 65° - 40° = 25°, so ∠DHO = 25°.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中四边形呈风筝/菱形状，A 在左，C 在右，AC 是水平对角线；D 在上，B 在下，BD 与 AC 交于 O；从 D 向 AB 作垂线，垂足为 H，并且连有 OH，图中 H 处有直角标记。题设给出 ∠CAD=25°，要求 ∠DHO。

按坐标斜率法：取 O 为原点，AC 为 x 轴，BD 为 y 轴。根据图中的对称形状，设 A=(-1,0)，D=(0,t)，B=(0,-t)。射线 AC 从 A 指向 x 轴正方向，AD 的方向向量为 (1,t)，所以直线 AD 与正 x 轴夹角为 arctan(t)。由 ∠CAD=25°，得 t=tan25°。

直线 AB 经过 A=(-1,0)、B=(0,-t)，斜率为 -t，所以 AB 的方程为 y=-t(x+1)。因为 DH⊥AB，故 DH 的斜率为 1/t，且过 D=(0,t)，所以 DH 的方程为 y=t+x/t。

求 H：联立 y=-t(x+1) 与 y=t+x/t，得 -t(x+1)=t+x/t，解得 x_H=-2t^2/(1+t^2)，y_H=-t(1-t^2)/(1+t^2)。因此 HD 的斜率为 1/t=cot25°=tan65°，即 HD 与正 x 轴夹角为 65°。

又 O=(0,0)，所以 HO 的斜率为 (0-y_H)/(0-x_H)=y_H/x_H=(1-t^2)/(2t)。代入 t=tan25°，得到 HO 的斜率为 cot50°=tan40°，即 HO 与正 x 轴夹角为 40°。

所以 ∠DHO 是直线 HD 与 HO 的夹角，等于 65°-40°=25°。

求 H：联立 y=-t(x+1) 与 y=t+x/t，得 -t(x+1)=t+x/t，解得 x_H=-2t^2/(1+t^2)，y_H=-t(1-t^2)/(1+t^2)。因此 HD 的斜率为 1/t=cot25°=tan65°，即 HD 与正 x 轴夹角为 65°。

又 O=(0,0)，所以 HO 的斜率为 (0-y_H)/(0-x_H)=y_H/x_H=(1-t^2)/(2t)。代入 t=tan25°，得到 HO 的斜率为 cot50°=tan40°，即 HO 与正 x 轴夹角为 40°。

所以 ∠DHO 是直线 HD 与 HO 的夹角，等于 65°-40°=25°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a kite, with diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersecting at point $O$, and $DH \perp AB$ at point $H$. Connect $OH$, and $\angle CAD=25^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle DHO$?
raw_record.answer: Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus, it follows that $AD=AB$, $BO=OD$, $\angle DAO=\angle BAO=25^\circ$, and $AC\perp BD$. Therefore $\angle ABD=65^\circ$. Since $DH\perp AB$ and $BO=DO$, it follows that $HO=DO$. Thus $\angle DHO=\angle BDH=90^\circ-\angle ABD=\boxed{25^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A is on the left, C is on the right, D is above, B is below, and quadrilateral ABCD is in a kite shape; diagonal AC passes approximately horizontally through point O, and BD also passes through O; point H is located on side AB, and in the figure there is a right-angle mark at H, indicating DH ⟂ AB; segment OH has been connected. Reasoning: Because the kite in the figure has AC as its axis of symmetry, AC bisects ∠DAB and perpendicularly bisects BD, so O is the midpoint of DB. It is known that ∠CAD=25°, and O lies on AC, so ∠DAO=25°, hence ∠DAB=50°. Also, from the equality of adjacent sides of the kite, AB=AD, so triangle ABD is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠ABD=∠BDA=(180°-50°)/2=65°. Since H lies on AB, ∠DBH=∠DBA=65°; also DH ⟂ AB, so triangle DBH is a right triangle at H, therefore ∠BDH=90°-65°=25°. In right triangle DBH, O is the midpoint of hypotenuse DB, therefore OD=OH. Thus triangle DOH is an isosceles triangle, and O lies on DB, so ∠HDO=∠BDH=25°, hence ∠DHO=25°.
